headline: Mickey Mouse whistles his way to fame

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen twenty-eight... a whistling mouse sailed onto a New York screen.

scenes.label: Colony Theatre, New York
scenes.caption: Theatre bill, November 1928
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Steamboat Willie premiered at the Colony Theatre... Mickey Mouse's public debut.

scenes.label: minutes of cartoon history
scenes.text: [calmly] It ran under eight minutes. Walt Disney did the voices.

scenes.label: Steamboat Willie
scenes.caption: Captain Pete, 1928
scenes.text: [softly] It wasn't the first sound cartoon, but it took sound to the masses.

scenes.title: Free for everyone
scenes.text: [warmly] In twenty twenty-four, it entered the public domain.
[warmly] Follow On This Day USA... for a new story from history, every day.
